services.desc: The Adirondack Mountain Club is dedicated to connecting people with the natural world - protecting wild spaces, inspiring exploration, and making every adventure accessible, from your very first hike to your most ambitious summit. Every trail maintained, every summit protected, and every hiker inspired happens because people like you care. Your support - through membership, donations, volunteering, or advocacy - powers ADK’s mission to protect wild places and connect people with the outdoors.
